plan.reason: At 24/100 evaluations with 5 stagnant steps and no recent improvement, the surrogate is still data-poor, so auto selection lets held-out RMSE choose between RBF and quadratic rather than committing early. current_to_best operator balances exploitation of the incumbent with DE differential diversity, suited for a 5D bounded landscape. Exploration is raised to 0.6 to break stagnation via novelty in standardized predicted-objective-minus-distance acquisition, while local_fraction 0.4 and radius 0.15 (normalized) keep a meaningful share of candidates in refined local search without over-concentrating. Population 30 and generations 5 cap surrogate generations per cycle to conserve the fixed true-evaluation budget, leaving room for iterative updates as more data arrives.

At 44/100 evaluations with only mild recent improvement (0.0085) and low stagnation of 2, the search is not strongly stalled, but high CV normalized RMSE (0.42) signals a noisy or imperfect surrogate, so auto selection lets held-out RMSE pick RBF vs quadratic rather than committing. current_to_best maintains a balance of incumbent exploitation and differential diversity for a 5D bounded landscape. Exploration is reduced from the prior 0.6 to 0.35 since novelty-heavy search is less needed with low stagnation, leaving the surrogate prediction to guide more. local_fraction 0.35 and radius 0.12 keep a moderate local refinement share without over-concentrating, and population 28 with 5 generations caps per-cycle surrogate use to conserve the fixed true-evaluation budget.

At 64/100 evaluations with stagnation 7 and tiny recent improvement (~0.001), the search is stalling, so raise exploration modestly from 0.35 to 0.5 to inject novelty while keeping surrogate-guided exploitation via current_to_best. CV RMSE ~0.43 means the surrogate is noisy, so auto lets held-out RMSE choose between RBF and quadratic rather than committing. Slightly lower mutation (0.55) and local_fraction (0.3) with radius 0.1 balance refinement around incumbents against the novelty needed to escape stagnation. Population 26 and 5 generations keep per-cycle surrogate cost moderate to respect the tight remaining budget (36 evaluations) without overspending generations.

Only 16 evaluations remain, so each surrogate cycle must be cheap: population 24 with 4 generations limits per-cycle candidate evaluations. Stagnation at 4 with small recent improvement suggests mild stalling rather than deep stagnation, so exploration is raised modestly to 0.65 to add novelty while current_to_best still exploits. CV RMSE ~0.37 indicates noisy surrogate, so auto lets held-out RMSE arbitrate RBF vs quadratic instead of committing. Moderate mutation 0.6, crossover 0.85, local_fraction 0.25 and radius 0.08 focus refinement near incumbents without ignoring the novelty term.
